nodes.label: ETH Wallet Tab
nodes.rationale: Standalone ETH Wallet tab on the same seed-derived address AtomiX uses — ERC20 add-by-contract, Low/Med/High fee tiers, receive/QR, export key, Etherscan links, custom RPC. Deliberately reuses AtomiX's ETH engine so no new crypto code is introduced.

nodes.label: ETH Wallet Fund-Safety Review Fixes (0.16.1)
nodes.rationale: A deep fund-safety review found and fixed: the fee-tier selector (engine floor was masking the tiers), a hostile-RPC gas-drain path (gas + base fee both clamped), a duplicate-send lock, broadcast-ambiguity handling, EIP-55 checksum, and a token-file DoS. An executable test harness was added.

nodes.label: Web Wallet (MegaMMR-gated wallet-from-seed)
nodes.rationale: A local wallet-from-seed where keys stay on-device, gated on MegaMMR. Balance display was fixed to show confirmed (not sendable) so a funded foreign seed no longer reads zero (0.15.4-0.15.7).

nodes.label: Clipboard-via-Main-Process Fix (0.15.8)
nodes.rationale: Clipboard copy now routes through the Electron main process because the renderer's navigator.clipboard was silently failing when the window was unfocused, so the 'Copied' confirmation lied to the user.

nodes.label: Cross-platform Builds (0.13.0)
nodes.rationale: Windows (NSIS .exe) and Linux (.AppImage) builds added via the GitHub Actions matrix alongside the macOS .dmg; since 0.13.0 installers are attached to the matching GitHub Release.

nodes.label: Vestr Token-Vesting Module
nodes.rationale: Token-vesting tab with a shared covenant and 3-way interop with the native apps (0.11.0).

nodes.label: AtomiX Atomic-Swap Module
nodes.rationale: The AtomiX atomic-swap tab is the 3rd interoperating AtomiX peer and reuses the byte-identical MDS engine, with full Swap + Market + maker parity and later a native 'My market / ladder' cockpit.

nodes.label: HTLC Preimage Verification Fix (0.11.2)
nodes.rationale: Critical fix: AtomiX now verifies that a harvested HTLC preimage actually hashes to the lock before pinning it, closing a path where a bogus preimage could be trusted.

nodes.label: Shared-node Fund Hazard Fixes (0.8.x)
nodes.rationale: On a shared node: order/mail sends are pinned to a signable coin so anyone-can-spend beacon dust cannot NPE the signer (0.8.8, 0.8.10); PandaPools owner-key self-heal runs before Withdraw/Migrate/Collect (0.8.3); and a node RPC POST bug where large commands silently no-op'd (missing Content-Length) was fixed (0.8.11).

nodes.label: miniMall On-chain Shop Module
nodes.rationale: On-chain shop + vendor inbox + studio, built as the 3rd interop peer of the native miniMall apps (0.9.0-0.9.2).

nodes.label: Local SQLite Transaction History
nodes.rationale: Deep, locally-owned transaction history stored in SQLite with search/filter and per-token deltas; pool-swap history was fixed to capture both legs (MINIMA + real mxUSDT tokenamount) and read Bought/Sold correctly.

nodes.label: TERMINAL Design-System Reskin (0.6.x)
nodes.rationale: Full 'TERMINAL' reskin: black/white/orange, Manrope + Geist Mono, dark default with light toggle, adaptive wide nav-rail, sliding tab indicator, version pill.

nodes.label: PandaPools AMM Module
nodes.rationale: The PandaPools 'Pools' AMM tab is a 3rd parity peer that reuses the MDS engine byte-identical (0.4.0), brought to full frozen-quote swap + USDT-anchored create parity with the dapp.

nodes.label: Individual|Combined Pool View Toggle (0.16.2)
nodes.rationale: Folds every pool of a token into one collective-pool card (summed reserves + aggregate price + count + tradeable depth) via a Decimal-exact read-model helper. Deliberately display-only: the byte-identical PandaPools engine files are untouched to preserve 3-way parity with native 0.9.17 + MDS 0.6.8.

nodes.label: minimaMail On-chain Encrypted Messenger
nodes.rationale: Full on-chain encrypted messenger at 100% feature parity with the native Mail APK — in-chat sends, rename/archive, QR scan, passphrase backup/restore.
